Title in pencil. Alternate title from P. L. Phillips' A list of maps of America: Map of the route of Gen. William Tryon's expedition to Danbury. Manuscript, pen-and-ink and watercolor. Has watermarks. Relief shown by hachures. Stamped on verso: Montresor. Scale ca. 1:80,000. LC Maps of North America, 1750-1789, 1025 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2
